facts.statement: A community event called a Robgoblin party was held at the Robgoblin camp north of the Villadelago teleport stone, with music, dancing and fun; players were encouraged to wear robes.
facts.quote: Nuestro próximo evento comunitario será en el campamento robgoblin al norte de la piedra tele-transportadora de Villadelago.

facts.statement: The Robgoblin party ran Thursday 13 January 2011 at 1500 Pacific Time for US and Latin America, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jueves 13 de enero del 2011 1500 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: A second run of the Robgoblin party was held Friday 14 January 2011 at 0900 Pacific Time (1800 European time) for UK and Europe, on Server 1.
facts.quote: viernes 14 de enero del 2011 0900 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico/1800 hrs Timepo Europeo (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta Robgoblin
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event announcement for a Robgoblin party held at the Robgoblin camp north of the Villadelago teleport stone, where Palorroto the mage trainer is located. The article gives the event dates and times for the US/Latin America and UK/Europe audiences on Server 1, and explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar. The posting date is not shown; the page only says 'Posted 4 months, 3 weeks ago.'
